doc.title: Germaine Bazzle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006

title: Singer as another horn in the band
summary: Rowe compares this to Joe Williams; she takes it as a compliment and describes riffing with her tenor player.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Well musicians talk about singers in that regard sometimes. They say well she’s like having another horn in the band.
I remember people saying that about Joe Williams who we knew pretty well.
That he was like another horn in the band. Is that a compliment to you?

I think so because I know that I’m limited in that sound but wherever I am, whatever I can do within my range, I think that’s — oh that’s a wonderful compliment which means I was able to pull it off. But now I’m working with a group at home and the tenor player and I, whenever anybody is taking a solo he and I will get together and we’ll do some kind of little riff.
You know, a little background riff or something like that. And it’s all a joy. It’s all a joy for me.
